statement: For every symmetric binary integer99-by-99 matrix A with zero diagonal and every integer row sum14, let R=A^2+A-12I-2J, M=R modulo3, H be its whole unordered off-diagonal nonzero support and S the whole nonisolated vertex set of size m. For each u in S put beta_u=2c1(u)+c2(u) and d_u=c1(u)+c2(u), where c1,c2 count incident residue-one and residue-two entries. For any nonempty class C of k distinct vertices in S having identical actual A-neighborhoods outside S, every distinct u,v in C satisfies R_uv>=13-floor(m/2). With b(0)=0,b(1)=2,b(2)=1, W_uu=0 and W_uv=(R_uv+b(M_uv))/3 for u!=v, W is symmetric nonnegative integer and sum_v W_uv=beta_u/3 for u in S. Writing g=max(0,ceil((13-floor(m/2))/3)), every u in C has W_uv>=g for each other v in C, beta_u>=3(k-1)g and d_u>=ceil(3(k-1)g/2). Empty M support is permitted.
